name: Is a professionally mortared tile backsplash better than peel-and-stick tile?

mainEntity.name: Is a professionally mortared tile backsplash better than peel-and-stick tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: A peel-and-stick backsplash works as a temporary cosmetic fix, but mortared tile is the better choice for permanent durability and home value. Adhesive sticker tiles can loosen and peel when exposed to moisture from sinks and heat from cooktops. Real ceramic, porcelain, or stone tile set in thin-set mortar bonds permanently to the wall and handles heat, steam, and everyday cleaning without lifting. While mortared tile requires a larger upfront investment and professional installation, it offers lasting performance and protects the underlying wall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Mortared tile forms a permanent, heat-resistant, and water-resistant bond, whereas peel-and-stick tiles tend to peel over time near moisture and stove heat.
